heading: Two practices. Hire the one you need.
intro: You do not need to become a bookkeeping client to work with our systems practice, and you do not need an automation project to hire us for bookkeeping.

columns.label: Practice 01
columns.body: We examine how work moves through your firm, find the handoffs creating unnecessary effort, and build the systems to improve them. The work can stand alone or begin with an AI Operations Audit.
bullets: System integrations that let software exchange information
Workflow automation for repeatable back-office processes
Data infrastructure, reporting, and focused internal AI tools

columns.label: Practice 02
columns.body: Monthly bookkeeping owned by an Enrolled Agent with more than 25 years in accounting. For firms that want their numbers to answer the questions owners are actually asking—not merely satisfy a tax filing.
bullets: Full-cycle monthly bookkeeping and month-end close
QuickBooks Online setup, cleanup, and ongoing books
Multi-entity books and connected financial workflows
Direct communication with the person responsible for the work

bridge: Each practice stands on its own. The advantage of having them under one roof appears when a workflow touches both operations and financial information: you do not have to explain the business twice, and the people solving the problem already speak both languages.
